svg.title: How new productive forces can reshape production relations
svg.desc: New productive forces change intelligent capabilities and execution costs. This prompts a reassessment of business and the division of work, followed by changes to production relations and the production environment. The resulting shared digital environment may take the form of an Enterprise OS or an Industry OS.

g.text: Intelligent capabilities and execution costs change
Reassess the business and division of work
First ask what needs to be done, then who should do it
Reshape production relations and the production environment
Functions, authority, rules, collaboration, and systems adjust together
A shared business environment within a company
A shared business environment across companies
How might new productive forces reshape organizations and their environments?
